scope: hosted public application-schema baseline only; managed Auth/Storage and infrastructure not included

checks.name: both supplied staging and isolated restore application schemas are empty
backup credential belongs to exact staging target
actual hosted baseline exported over verified TLS
private baseline checksum verified after readback
